title: PS Events: Reinventing Europe – Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala
gist: WTO chief Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala argues Europe's reinvention should build on what already works, pursuing measured reforms rather than panic and deepening trade ties with Africa. Article is a short video blurb.

insights.claim: The global trading system has proven surprisingly resilient in recent years, according to WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala.
insights.speaker: PS EDITORS
insights.so_what: Resilience of trade cuts against narratives of imminent trading-system collapse.

insights.claim: Europe lacks a tech giant to rival those in the US or China but remains a global trade powerhouse and a leader in science and research.
insights.speaker: PS EDITORS
insights.so_what: European strengths lie in trade and research rather than platform champions.

insights.claim: Europe should pursue measured reforms rather than act out of panic, and seize new opportunities such as closer trade and investment ties with Africa.
insights.speaker: PS EDITORS
insights.so_what: Signals Europe-Africa trade and investment as a growth avenue to watch.
